production_baseline.construction: Server Agent 1.4.0 runtime plus the official 1.4.1 overlay (agent.php, lib/PipelineExecutor.php, lib/SelfUpgradeManager.php) — see 1.4.1-lineage.json. lib/OperationRegistry.php and the deployment-service-reload helper were deliberately preserved unchanged by that overlay, so Production's active runtime still carries the 1.4.0-vintage implementation of both.

notes: Root-cause fix (Control Job #1, 'Could not create the Server Agent upgrade staging directory'): the unprivileged deployment-agent service user cannot create a new directory entry directly under root-owned /opt, so SelfUpgradeManager.php's old sibling-of-install-dir staging path could never succeed. This is the ONE additional exceptional bootstrap release this problem requires: 1.4.1's own SelfUpgradeManager cannot deliver 1.4.2 to itself, because it fails before it ever reaches staging — see upgrade-1.4.2.sh, which installs this release the same manual-overlay pattern 1.4.0 and 1.4.1 themselves used.

lib/SelfUpgradeManager.php is a CANDIDATE file in this release, not preserved: staging now lives inside a pre-provisioned, deployment-agent-owned deployment-server-agent-staging directory (a sibling of the install dir, so rename() stays atomic) instead of a brand-new sibling entry directly under /opt; the final atomic swap is delegated to the new deployment-server-agent-activate privileged helper instead of an in-process rename().

install/deployment-server-agent-activate (+ .sudoers) is a new, narrowly-scoped privileged helper this release installs — it performs ONLY the backup-aside + staged-in atomic swap, re-validates the staging layout itself, rejects any staging name outside a strict hex allowlist, rejects symlinked paths, and proves same-filesystem via device ids before ever renaming anything. /opt itself is never made group/world/deployment-agent-writable.

This release also provisions the permanent deployment-server-agent-staging directory (owned by deployment-agent, mode 0700, sibling of the install dir) that every FUTURE Hub-driven self-upgrade depends on — see upgrade-1.4.2.sh's own provisioning step.
lib/PipelineExecutor.php and lib/OperationRegistry.php are unchanged from 1.4.1 and are verified identical on both sides, not overlaid.

rollback.source: the run_id-scoped, SHA-256-verified backup captured from the active server before activation
